user.title: Homeslice
user.description: Adds the Homeslice card to your dashboards. Put your house model in `homeslice/home.yaml` inside your configuration folder.

missing_area.title: Homeslice: area {ref} no longer exists
missing_area.description: House **{house}** links {where} to the area `{ref}`, which Home Assistant doesn't have anymore. Link the room to another area or restore the area.

missing_floor.title: Homeslice: floor {ref} no longer exists
missing_floor.description: House **{house}** links {where} to the floor `{ref}`, which Home Assistant doesn't have anymore. Link the level to another floor or restore the floor.

missing_entity.title: Homeslice: entity {ref} no longer exists
missing_entity.description: House **{house}** uses `{ref}` for the {where}, but Home Assistant doesn't know this entity anymore. Pick another entity or remove the link.

import_files.name: Import house files
import_files.description: Imports every YAML file in the homeslice folder of your configuration into Homeslice's storage. The file name is the house id.
